Sophie (CS): Heads-up — NimbusCare renewal is paused. Procurement wants SOC2 attestation attached to the contract and the PO lists a different VAT ID than the one on file. They need a signed agreement to release payment.
Diego (Sales): Customer says their AP requires attestation files before they can process any PO. Ravi, can you upload SOC2 report or give a link?
Ravi (NimbusCare): Sorry about that — our security team provided a redacted SOC2 Type II last quarter. Uploading now: https://files.nimbuscare.example/soc2_redacted_q3.pdf
Hannah (Finance): The PO number NIM-2026-551 is fine but VAT ID on PO is IE555-999. Our contract record shows VAT IE555-998. AP will reject mismatch. Can you confirm correct VAT?
Ravi (NimbusCare): Yikes — that's a typo. Correct VAT is IE555-998. I'll send an amended PO.
Tom (Legal): For SOC2 we should avoid attaching the full report to the contract; instead link to a hosted secure artifact and add a short attestation clause: "Customer confirms they have reviewed Redwood's SOC2 report on [link]". Is that acceptable?
Sophie (CS): Compliance Bot, any automated check we can run?
Compliance Bot: SOC2 link scanned: redacted report detected, date 2025-11-12. No restricted PII found. Recommendation: add attestation line and record link in renewal notes.
Diego (Sales): If they reissue PO with VAT IE555-998 and upload the signed amendment, we can update DocuSign. @Tom please confirm that an attestation clause + hosted link is OK for long-term record.
Tom (Legal): Attestation + hosted link is fine. Also require a short email from Customer Security: "We confirm the SOC2 report at [link] applies to Redwood integrations as of [date]." That email will be attached to the agreement.
Ravi (NimbusCare): Sending security note and reissued PO now.
Ravi (NimbusCare): Uploaded: https://files.nimbuscare.example/po_nim_551_amend.pdf
Ravi (NimbusCare): Security email: "We confirm the SOC2 report at https://files.nimbuscare.example/soc2_redacted_q3.pdf applies to Redwood integrations as of 2026-03-25." Attached signed PDF.
Hannah (Finance): Received amended PO NIM-2026-551 with VAT IE555-998. Good. We'll accept invoice once DocuSign completes.
Sophie (CS): Creating envelope env-nim-551, adding attestation clause and link in appendix.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope env-nim-551 status=sent
Ravi (NimbusCare): Signing now.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope env-nim-551 status=completed
Hannah (Finance): Invoice created referencing NIM-2026-551, due Net30, charge date 2026-04-05.
Sophie (CS): Closing loop — renewal delayed ~24hrs for SOC2/VAT fix. Action items: sales to capture VAT early; legal to add standard SOC2 attestation clause to renewal template; CS to note compliance link in CRM.
Diego (Sales): Noted. I'll add VAT and SOC2 checklist to renewal outreach template.
Ravi (NimbusCare): Thanks team — appreciate the clear guidance.
Sophie (CS): Marked renewal complete in CRM and scheduled onboarding kickoff.
